messages.text: I’m aware that it will be shipping at the end of November. I’m not getting 3x bolt credits on the harlo bitcoin cash pool
Searched the web · Harlo bitcoin cash pool bolt credits 3x
Searched the web · Harlo Pool 3x Bolts multiplier Harlo OS

I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist, and I'll help you with the Bolts.

I couldn't find a 3x Bolts offer anywhere I can check. The 
Harlo Pool page
 describes one free spin every 4 hours and doesn't mention a multiplier. I also can't open the pool site or its terms from here. I'd rather not guess, so where did you see the 3x offer? A screenshot, email or link would help.

While you look for that, these are the conditions for getting spins at all:

1. **The pool account is set up.** 
Log in at pool.harlolabs.com with your email and link your BCH wallet.

2. **The miner is pointed at the right address:** `stratum+tcp://pool.harlolabs.com:8888`, 
Worker: your BCH address. Password: x
. That needs to be the same BCH address you linked to your account.
3. **One miner reaches the hashrate on its own.** 
One miner has to hold 800 GH/s for a full hour. Two small miners don't add up, and a gap over 5 minutes restarts the hour.

4. **You open the spins yourself.** 
Every 4 hours a spin credit lands in your pool account. Open the pool site and hit Spin.
 Also, 
not every spin wins. Some spins award zero Bolts.


Your H15 hasn't shipped yet, so which miner are you running on the pool right now? About what hashrate does it show? And are spin credits showing up for you, just with fewer Bolts than you expected?
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Handed to the team · I can't see the pool's bonus logic or account data, and I don't know whether 3x

Thanks, Emilio, that screenshot answers my questions.

**What the screenshot shows:**
- The "HeliumDeploy Spin Multiplier Bonus" card says **2x bonus active**, which means 2 spins every 4 hours.
- Your purchase email shows as permanently linked to the pool account.
- The same card says the Harlo B30 and Harlo H15 give **3x** (3 spins every 4 hours).
- Your linked BCH wallet shows "Eligible to earn spin credits", "60+ minutes" and "Miner connected · any firmware."

So your mining setup is fine. You're earning spins, just at 2x instead of 3x.

The likely gap is that your H15 order (Shop····) hasn't shipped yet. It ships November 30. I can't see how the pool decides on the 3x bonus. It could start when you buy, when the unit ships, or only after someone links it by hand. I don't want to guess which.

I've passed this to the team with your screenshot details. They're back Monday at 10am ET, and the answer will come to your email.

There's nothing to change on your miner in the meantime. Keep mining as you are, and your 2 spins every 4 hours will keep landing.
Thanks. I’ll keep an eye out for a response
You're welcome, Emilio. Your spins will keep coming at 2x until then. If anything changes on the miner or the pool page before Monday, message here and I'll take a look. Happy mining!
